blocks.text: Machine learning aaj ki zindagi ke bohat se shobon mein istemal hoti hai. Yeh idaron ko bohat sara data jaldi parakhne mein madad deti hai, jaise healthcare (sehat), business, education (taleem) aur rozmarra zindagi mein (Figure 6.5). Bohat se systems seekhe hue patterns se khud ba khud kaam karte hain. Is se insani mehnat kam hoti hai aur waqt bachta hai.
Use of Machine Learning in Healthcare (sehat mein)

Healthcare mein machine learning medical data parakhti hai aur bimari ki detection (pehchan) aur diagnosis (tashkhees, bimari ka pata lagana) mein madad deti hai. Misal ke taur par yeh medical images mein cancer ke cells dhoondne, Alzheimer ya dementia (yaaddasht ki bimari) ki shuru ki nishaniyan pehchanne, aur cardiovascular (dil aur khoon ki nalion ki) bimariyon ki tashkhees mein madad kar sakti hai. Doctor in results se behtar aur waqt par ilaj ka mansooba bana sakte hain.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Ek saada dataset lein, jaise talaba ke marks aur grades. Talaba khud tay karein ke kaun sa data training ke liye aur kaun sa testing ke liye istemal ho sakta hai.

blocks.alt: Darmiyani daira 'machine learning' chaar dabbon se jura: Sehat (tibbi tashkhees, khatre ka andaza, dawa ki daryaft), Karobar (gahakon ki baseerat, dhoka-dahi ki pakar, farokht ka andaza), Taleem (dhalti parhai, talaba ki jaanch, tutoring systems) aur Rozmarra zindagi (virtual assistants, tajaweez, smart ghar).
blocks.caption: Machine learning ke istemal (Fig 6.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Wahi chand khayalat, darja-bandi, andaza aur tajweez, har shobe mein aate hain; sirf data badalta hai.

blocks.text: Use of Machine Learning in Business (karobar mein)

Businesses machine learning se customers ka rawaiya (behavior) samajhte hain. Yeh sales (farokht) aur market ke trends ka andaza lagane mein madad deti hai, aur inventory management (stock ka hisab) mein bhi kaam aati hai. Misalein: financial systems mein fraud (dhoka) pakarna, robots ya chatbots ke zariye customer service, aur customers ko products tajweez karna. Machine learning se marketing ki strategies zyada asar-dar ho jati hain, aur business ke faisle data par mabni (data-driven) ho jate hain. Is se munafa (profit) aur efficiency barhti hai.
Use of Machine Learning In Education (taleem mein)

Taleem mein machine learning seekhne ke systems behtar banati hai. Yeh talaba ki performance par nazar rakhne mein madad deti hai taake un ke grades behtar hon. Har talib-e-ilm ko us ke mutabiq (personalized) parhai ka mawad milta hai. Hazri (attendance) aur assessment (jaanch) ke systems zyada smart ho jate hain, aur seekhne ke nataij behtar hote hain.
Everyday Applications of Machine Learning (rozmarra zindagi mein)

Machine learning rozana ke kaamon mein istemal hoti hai. Mobile phones isay face recognition (chehra pehchan kar phone kholna) ke liye istemal karte hain. Voice assistants bole hue commands samajhte hain. Social media har shakhs ko us ki pasand ka content dikhata hai. Email services spam messages alag kar deti hain. Navigation apps raste batati hain. Online platforms videos aur music tajweez karte hain. Smart devices machine learning istemal karte hain, aur rozana ke kaam asaan aur tez ho jate hain.

blocks.prompt: Pakistan ki rozmarra zindagi se machine learning ka ek istemal batayein, aur bataein ke yeh zyada tar classification (darja-bandi), prediction (andaza) ya recommendation (tajweez) hai.
blocks.explanation: Misal: ride-hailing app ka kiraya aur pohanchne ka waqt batana prediction hai; phone ka spam call warning dena classification hai; video app ka drame tajweez karna recommendation hai. (Doosri munasib misalein bhi sahi hain.)

items: Healthcare: medical data se bimari ki pehchan aur tashkhees.
Business: customer behavior, sales ka andaza, inventory, fraud, chatbots, product tajaweez.
Education: performance par nazar, personalized parhai, smart attendance aur assessment.
Rozmarra: face recognition, voice assistants, spam filter, navigation, recommendations.
